description: This file defines the LiveSignalPub interface, which provides methods for publishing live signals (commands, events, messages) in an actor-based system for the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes a static factory method to instantiate the publisher within an ActorContext.

classes.name: LiveSignalPub
classes.description: An interface providing access to publish live signals (commands, events, messages) and a static factory method to instantiate implementations within an actor system.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a LiveSignalPub instance for a given ActorContext.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Returns a DistributedPub for publishing Command objects.

methods.name: event
methods.description: Returns a DistributedPub for publishing Event objects.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Returns a DistributedPub for publishing Signal objects.
